name: Tosashimizu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tosashimizu city emblem in black: a ring crossed by winged horizontal bars enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Tosashimizu, a city in Kōchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 25 January 1955.

features.role: Tosashimizu city emblem — a ring crossed by winged horizontal bars enclosing a stylised character
